name: rs
description: Rastersysteme slide deck tools — compose, render, QA, gallery, and more

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run a skill across all decks in batch — splice-images, qa-visual, render, compose, or any per-deck operation.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Run multi-variant comparison of a deck across intensity levels and themes, with rubric evaluation and side-by-side review.

commands.name: compose
commands.description: Run Claude-directed composition on source markdown — assigns design directives (grid zones, typography, colors, accents) to each slide.

commands.name: delete-slide
commands.description: Remove one or more slides from a composed markdown deck, with confirmation and re-render.

commands.name: design-system
commands.description: Manage design systems — list, preview, generate new ones, or apply a saved system to a deck.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Visual diff between two versions of a composed deck — shows which slides changed, what directives were modified, and side-by-side rendering.

commands.name: edit-slide
commands.description: Edit a specific slide's content, design directive, or layout in a composed markdown deck. Reads context and verifies in Chrome.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a slide deck to PDF or PPTX format.

commands.name: imagine
commands.description: Generate consistent image prompts for each slide in a deck, with a visual thread that connects the entire series. Optionally generate images.

commands.name: insert-slide
commands.description: Insert a new slide into a composed markdown deck at a specific position, with a design directive that fits the surrounding context.

commands.name: pace
commands.description: Add timing cues to slide speaker notes based on presentation duration. Estimates time per slide from content weight.

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Open a slide deck in Chrome and navigate to a specific slide for visual inspection. Supports interactive browsing.

commands.name: qa-fix-loop
commands.description: Autonomous cycle that audits a deck for accessibility and design issues, fixes them, re-renders, and verifies. Loops until clean or the user stops.

commands.name: qa-visual
commands.description: Run a visual accessibility and design consistency audit on an HTML slideshow using Claude in Chrome.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Re-render an HTML slide deck from its composed markdown source. Rebuilds after edits, optionally splices images and reloads in Chrome.

commands.name: splice-images
commands.description: Merge generated images into an HTML slide deck with intelligent, collision-aware placement.

commands.name: studio
commands.description: Open the studio viewer — a precision presentation tool with grid view, QA panel, and speaker notes.
